title: The Pudding Skin on the Brown Bowl
youtube_title: The Pudding Skin on the Brown Bowl | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Kavi wants to check on a rice pudding waiting for its soft skin before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Kavi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
